units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 78b:16">B. Bath. 78ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>ונירם</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 21:30">Num. XXI, 30</cite>) <he>אמר רשע אין רם</he> the wicked says, there is no Most High.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:19">Num. R. s. 20<sup>19</sup></cite> (play on <cite ref="A03164"><he>ארם</he></cite>, <cite ref="Numbers 23:7">Num. XXIII, 7</cite>) <he>עם רם שלמעלן הייתי וכ׳</he> with the Most High I was in communion, and Balak brought me down; <cite ref="Numbers 23:7">ib.</cite> <he>רם הייתי וכ׳</he> I was high, but Balak &c.

Sot. 32ᵇ בקול רם in a high (loud) voice. Y. ib. VII, 21ᶜ top (ref. to Deut. XXVII, 14) כקולו של רם like the voice of the Most High; a. fr.—Fem. רָמָה. Mekh. B’shall., s. 1 (ref. to Ex. XIV, 8) שהיתה ידן … ר׳ על וכ׳ Israel’s power was high above the Egyptians’; a. e.—Pl. רָמִים; רָמוֹת. Num. R. l. c. מן הר׳ הייתי וכ׳ I was one of the elevated.
<cite ref="Ketubot 103b:22">Keth. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>נהוג נשיאותך בר׳</he> conduct thy office with the exalted (surround thyself with the best people; Var. <he>בדָמִים</he>, q. v.).
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:21">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 28</cite> <he>עיניך על ר׳ להשפילם</he> thy eyes are on the haughty to lower them; a. e.
